there are two different pathways for Ca2+-sensitization in rat vascular smooth muscle; a protein kinase-C-dependent pathway which is activated in the phorbol ester-treated rat aorta, and a protein-kinase-C-independent pathway which is activated via receptor agonists in normal rat aorta.

there are at least two pathways of Ca2+ sensitisation in vascular smooth muscle, and that one is protein kinase C dependent and the other is protein kinase C independent.
